article.story: MANHATTAN, Kan. -- — Brandon Rechsteiner scored 26 points with the help of six 3-pointers and Kansas State beat Cal State Northridge 95-78 on Friday. Rechsteiner's 6-for-15 effort from long range helped spearhead the Wildcats' 17-for-41 3-point performance; good for 41%. Reserves Matt Gilhool and Montana Wheeler each scored 12 for Kansas State (1-1). Mikah Ballew scored 23 points on 6-for-10 shooting from 3, BJ Omot scored 14 points, Josiah Davis 12 and Brooklyn Hicks 11 for Cal State Northridge (0-2). Rechsteiner's 3 with 15 minutes left before halftime broke an 11-all tie and the Wildcats never trailed again. Kansas State went on an offensive eruption from there and led 57-29 at halftime. Gilhool's 3 not long after halftime doubled the lead to 62-31. It was the first meeting between the two since 1987. Kansas State now leads the series 3-0. Up next Cal State Northridge: Hosts Grace University of Omaha, Nebraska, on Thursday. Kansas State: Hosts Creighton on Tuesday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
